actuator._comment: Real MCP server: the Spring Boot app serves an MCP streamable-HTTP endpoint at /actuator-mcp (spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc) exposing health/jvmUptimeSeconds/metric as tools backed by Actuator. Start it with `mvn spring-boot:run`, then `/mcp` reconnects. Tools: src/main/java/com/learnclaude/library/actuator/.
